<ic>Abrogate the motion raising the third Navarr army

<br><br><i>Proposed by Therunin, seconded by Sermersuaq</i></ic> 

===Overview===
* This motion [[Powers_of_the_Imperial_Senate#Abrogation|abrogates]] the [[Raise Navarr Army|motion]] to [[Army#Senate_Commissions|raise]] the third [[Navarr]] army
* Passed

===Date===
* Winter 380YE

===Campaign Outcome===
It is no longer legally possible to raise a third Navarr army without a new motion to approve it.
